## Infiltration.pressSpace() method

Press spacebar.

This is like [pressKey](./bitburner.infiltration.presskey.md)<!-- -->, but it works synchronously. This is useful for timing-critical minigames, or just as a simple way to press space. You can still use `pressKey(" ")` if you want to.

Requires API access.

**Signature:**

```typescript
pressSpace(): void;
```
**Returns:**

void
